candidates.name: Compatibility phase for TD-5
candidates.why: Ship the upgrade of TD-5 behind a compatibility layer (non-breaking) first.
assumptions: A compatibility layer keeps the old contract of issue:TD-5. This is an assumption, not proof of compatibility.

candidates.name: As proposed
candidates.why: The changes exactly as planned, in the order the dependency constraints require.
requiredReviews: Policy P3: Each impacted item must have a verifying test. Affected: issue:TD-2, issue:TD-3, issue:TD-6, issue:TD-4.

candidates.name: Split into separate phases
candidates.why: Ship interacting changes in separate releases, each reviewed on its own evidence.
assumptions: The end state after all phases equals the combined result: splitting resolves no conflict by itself. It lets each phase be approved and re-checked on fresh evidence.
requiredReviews: Policy P3: Each impacted item must have a verifying test. Affected: issue:TD-2, issue:TD-3, issue:TD-6, issue:TD-4.

limits: Candidates are proposals: nothing is executed or approved, and Jira is unchanged.
A retained or compatible variant is an assumption to verify, never proof that consumers keep working.
Consumer migrations are only ordered, never invented: a "migrate first" step needs a migration already in the plan.
